passages.heading: MD&A
passages.text: The following discussion should be read in conjunction with our consolidated financial statements and the notes thereto. This discussion summarizes the significant factors affecting our results of operations and the financial condition of our business. Except as otherwise indicated or unless the context otherwise requires, “Xylem,” “we,” “us,” “our” and “the Company” refer to Xylem Inc. and its subsidiaries. This section of this Form 10-K generally discusses 2025 and 2024 items and year-to-year comparisons between 2025 and 2024. Overview Xylem is a leading global water technology company. We design, manufacture and service highly engineered products and solutions ranging across a wide variety of critical applications in utility, industrial, residential and commercial building services settings. Our broad portfolio of solutions addresses customer needs across the water cycle, from the delivery, measurement and use of drinking water to the collection, test, treatment and analysis of wastewater, to the return of water to the environment. Our product and service offerings are organized into four reportable segments that are aligned around the critical market applications they provide: Water Infrastructure, Applied Water, Measurement and Control Solutions and Water Solutions and Services. • Water Infrastructure serves the water infrastructure sector with pump systems that transport water from aquifers, lakes, rivers and seas; with filtration, ultraviolet and ozone systems that provide treatment, making the water fit to use; and pumping solutions that move the wastewater and storm water to treatment facilities where our mixers, biological treatment, monitoring and control systems provide the primary functions in the treatment process. Additionally, our offerings use monitoring and control, smart and connected technologies to allow for remote monitoring of performance and enable products to self-optimize pump operations maximizing energy efficiency and minimizing unplanned downtime and maintenance for our customers. The Water Infrastructure segment also provides a range of highly differentiated and scalable products and technologies with product offerings in the filtration and separation, disinfection, and wastewater solutions, for municipal and industrial applications. In the Water Infrastructure segment we reach customers indirectly, through channel partners and distributors, directly and through our service capabilities. • Applied Water serves the water usage applications sector with water pressure boosting systems for heating, ventilation and air conditioning, and for fire protection systems to the residential and commercial building solutions markets. In addition, our pumps, heat exchangers and controls provide cooling to power plants and manufacturing facilities, circulation for food and beverage processing, and boosting systems for agricultural irrigation. passages.heading: Risk factors
passages.text: In evaluating our business and investment in our securities, investors should carefully consider the following discussion of material factors and events, along with all of the other information in this Report and in our other filings with the SEC. The events and consequences discussed below could, in circumstances that we may not be able to accurately predict, recognize or control, have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, cash flows, results of operations and/or market price of our common stock. Some of the factors, events, and contingencies discussed below may have occurred in the past, and the disclosures below are not representations as to whether or not the factors, events or contingencies have occurred in the past, but are provided because future occurrences of such factors, events, or contingencies could have a material adverse effect. These risk factors do not identify all of the risks we face. Our business is also subject to general risks that affect many other companies. In addition, we operate in a continually changing business, economic and geopolitical environment, and as a result, new risk factors, or changes to our risk profile, may emerge from time to time. Risks not currently known to us, or that we currently believe are immaterial, may impact our business, operations, financial condition or share price. The global macroeconomic and geopolitical climate amplify many of the risks below. Risks in this section are grouped in the following categories: (1) Risks Related to Geopolitical, Macroeconomic and Industry Factors; (2) Risks Related to Our Business and Operations; (3) Risks Related to Financial and Tax; and (4) Risks Related to Legal and Regulatory. Many risks affect more than one category, and as a result the risks are not in order of significance or probability of occurrence. Risks Related to Geopolitical, Macroeconomic and Industry Factors Industry and economic conditions may adversely affect our markets and our customers’ operating conditions and demand. With sales, directly or indirectly, in approximately 150 countries, we compete across a wide range of geographies and end markets. Economic and industry factors that have had, or may in the future have, a material impact on our businesses and demand for our products and services include: (i) overall strength of, and our customers’ confidence in, local and global macroeconomic conditions; (ii) inflation and related monetary policy actions by governments in response; (iii) overall strength of industrial, governmental, public and private sector spending; (iv) overall strength of the industrial, residential and commercial real estate markets; (v) federal, state, local and municipal governments’ environmental, energy efficiency, fiscal, trade and procurement laws, regulations and policies, including domestic content requirements; (vi) availability of commercial financing for our customers and end-users; and (vii) availability of funding for our public sector customers, including for water infrastructure investments. credit_strengths.text: XYL's net leverage is minimal and sits well below the sector median, reflecting a conservatively managed balance sheet. The company holds substantial cash against modest gross debt, and the indicative financial risk profile places it in the lowest risk tier. This provides significant headroom against the next leverage threshold, supporting strong credit quality.

Interest coverage is exceptionally high, far exceeding the sector median, indicating ample capacity to absorb higher borrowing costs. Operating income has grown steadily over the past three years, and the company's EBITDA proxy comfortably covers interest expense. This robust coverage underpins the minimal financial risk profile.

key_risks.text: XYL operates in approximately one hundred fifty countries, exposing it to macroeconomic, geopolitical, and regulatory risks that could materially affect demand. The risk factors highlight inflation, monetary policy, and public sector funding constraints as potential headwinds. These factors could pressure revenue and cash flow, particularly if economic slowdowns reduce customer spending on water infrastructure projects.

A significant portion of debt matures within the next twelve months, requiring refinancing or repayment. While the company's cash balance and operating cash flow provide ample coverage, a sharp deterioration in credit markets or cash generation could strain liquidity. The maturity profile also includes a sizable balloon payment after year five, necessitating long-term refinancing plans.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Operating cash flow covers debt service comfortably, with free cash flow to debt well above the sector median. The company generates substantial cash after capital expenditures, and its current ratio exceeds the sector median, indicating solid short-term liquidity. This supports the ability to meet maturing obligations without undue stress.

Interest expense is modest relative to operating income, and the company's cash position provides a buffer against refinancing risk. However, the upcoming maturity of a large debt tranche within the next year will require either refinancing or use of cash. Given the strong coverage and liquidity, we view this as manageable.

overall_credit_view.text: XYL exhibits a minimal financial risk profile, with leverage and cash flow metrics significantly stronger than sector medians. The company's consistent revenue and operating income growth, coupled with robust interest coverage, support a stable credit outlook. We view the issuer as having ample capacity to service debt and absorb moderate economic shocks.

Shareholder distributions and acquisitions absorb a portion of free cash flow, but the company retains substantial financial flexibility. The debt maturity profile is manageable given the strong cash position and cash generation. We consider the credit profile to be resilient, with no material data gaps affecting our assessment.

credit_strengths.text: XYL的淨槓桿極低，遠低於行業中位數，反映其資產負債表管理保守。公司持有大量現金，而總債務適中，且指示性財務風險狀況將其歸入最低風險級別。這為應對下一個槓桿門檻提供了顯著緩衝，支持強勁的信用質量。
利息覆蓋率極高，遠超行業中位數，表明有充足能力吸收更高的借貸成本。過去三年營業收入穩步增長，且公司的EBITDA代理指標輕鬆覆蓋利息支出。這種強勁的覆蓋支撐了極低的財務風險狀況。

key_risks.text: XYL在約一百五十個國家運營，使其面臨宏觀經濟、地緣政治和監管風險，這些風險可能對需求產生重大影響。風險因素強調通脹、貨幣政策和公共部門資金限制為潛在逆風。這些因素可能對收入和現金流造成壓力，特別是如果經濟放緩減少客戶在水基礎設施項目上的支出。
很大一部分債務將在未來十二個月內到期，需要再融資或償還。雖然公司的現金餘額和經營現金流提供了充足覆蓋，但信貸市場或現金生成急劇惡化可能使流動性緊張。到期結構還包括五年後的一筆巨額氣球還款，需要長期再融資計劃。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 經營現金流輕鬆覆蓋債務償付，自由現金流與債務之比遠高於行業中位數。公司在資本支出後產生大量現金，其流動比率超過行業中位數，表明短期流動性穩健。這支持了在不過度壓力的情況下履行到期義務的能力。
利息支出相對於營業收入適中，且公司的現金狀況為再融資風險提供了緩衝。然而，未來一年內一大筆債務到期將需要再融資或使用現金。鑑於強勁的覆蓋率和流動性，我們認為這是可管理的。

overall_credit_view.text: XYL展現出極低的財務風險狀況，槓桿和現金流指標顯著強於行業中位數。公司持續的收入和營業收入增長，加上強勁的利息覆蓋，支持穩定的信用展望。我們認為發行人擁有充足能力償還債務並吸收適度的經濟衝擊。
股東分配和收購吸收了部分自由現金流，但公司保留了顯著的財務靈活性。鑑於強勁的現金狀況和現金生成，債務到期結構是可管理的。我們認為信用狀況具有韌性，沒有影響我們評估的重大數據缺口。
